newsitem.title: USA: Shareholder files lawsuit against Yes!.
newsitem.headline: Shareholder files lawsuit against Yes!.

text.p: A shareholder of Yes! Entertainment Inc filed a lawsuit against the company Tuesday alleging some of the company's executives made false and misleading statements, an attorney for the shareholder said Wednesday.

The purported class action lawsuit was filed in California Superior Court by Tu Ming Wang on behalf of himself and on behalf of purchasers of Yes! common stock between October 23, 1996 and December 12, 1996.

The complaint alleges that defendants Yes!, its Chief Executive Officer Donald Kingsborough, Executive Vice President Bruce Bower and Chief Operating Officer Sol Kershner violated California law by issuing to the investing public false and misleading statements regarding Yes! current operations and future prospects. The complaint alleges that, as a result of these misrepresentations, the price of Yes!'s common stock was artificially inflated during the period.
